status: independent specification review passed; no blocking change required
release_authority: Architect only; this review does not freeze or authorize implementation

review_notes.finding: Complete coverage, exactly one genesis, same-claim existing predecessor, no fork/cycle, iterative traversal visiting every supplied event and unique terminal suffice for a complete supplied chain. No mutable registry or ledger is introduced. Assessment/reviewed_at are compared with the derived head; inputs and returned containers remain separate.
review_notes.authority: assessment-event schema oneOf; active plan 5.4 rules 3-7

review_notes.finding: Only the terminal fingerprint binds current evidence; historical genesis/human events may retain old FP. Human preserves parent FP; invalidation changes it, including provisional-to-provisional. Exact persisted UTF-8 text SHA across every event remains distinct from NFKC claim identity. Evidence order is irrelevant but multiplicity/relation/content remain material; bbox/charspan/symbol exclusions preserve identity.

Real Gregorian year/date/time plus explicit 1..9 fractional digits and Z is implementable with fullmatch and component validation without clock/time-zone lookup. Fractional spelling stays in event ID; graph order, not timestamp order, is authoritative. Do not round fractional digits or use an implicit ISO parser accepting offsets/leap seconds.

Virtual-root preflight charges keys/aliases before normalization/schema/hash; codec validation enforces per-locator wire cap. Claim text additionally has character-before-UTF8 65536 byte bound. Collision precedence after all claim shapes but before individual hash mismatch is explicit. Ordinary value preflight maps SCHEMA_INVALID, codec errors preserve their codes with evidence prefix, resources preserve LIMIT, collision exit75. Implement safe bounded diagnostics instead of passing identity helper messages containing claim text through unchanged.

Human no-op rejection is a deliberately narrower whole-history profile consistent with active plan 5.4 rule3; legacy per-event and prospective APIs remain unchanged. Retired claims are retained without inferring deprecated from lifecycle. No source schemas, identity, codec/runtime or dependency changes are required.

Cycles with genuine truncated self-referential event hashes require fixed points; end-to-end synthetic cycles may correctly fail EVENT_ID_MISMATCH first. A graph-only test with synthetic IDs or explicitly isolated identity stub must be labelled separately; do not disable production checks or claim a valid-hash cycle. Duplicate conflicting supplied claim bindings are testable without solving a real collision because precedence explicitly inspects stated IDs.

bounded_compatibility_controls.scope: Existing helper/schema only; independent event hashes and 4-event history specimen. No new history validator implementation or acceptance claim.

remaining_adapter_obligations: Complete active+retired enumeration and primary owner/source/artifact closure
Immutable event filenames/raw-byte provenance, signed/approved transaction receipts, human authorization and rollback resistance
Core replacement co-publication and invalidation followed by a separately authorized human transaction
